purpose: Distinct non-humanoid boss cutouts; inspired by the varied silhouettes and readable encounter rhythms of ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN, without copying its characters

assets.earthsplitter.png: Enormous non-humanoid burrowing cathedral centipede, armored segmented S-curve, digging claws, chisel head and circular maw, obsidian rock cracked by molten amber, three-quarter top-down painterly dark fantasy game sprite, genuine transparent background, no humanoid traits or text.
assets.storm-roc-v2.png: Isolated non-humanoid giant thunder roc with two broad wings, hooked beak, talons, black jagged feathers and cyan lightning veins, three-quarter overhead view, wings raised in a V, full body, genuine transparent alpha, no scenery, shadow or humanoid traits.
assets.moon-leviathan.png: Colossal non-humanoid abyssal leviathan, armored horned sea-serpent head, deep-sea maw, scaled body coiled around a broken blood-red moon, three-quarter top-down game art, genuine transparent background, no humanoid traits or text.

unused_storm_roc_variants: Two earlier imagegen attempts retained a broad opaque background; storm-roc-v2.png is the selected cutout.
